Enrich a Taxonomy File with iNaturalist Metadata

Source: R/inat.R
enrich_local_observed.Rd

Fill missing values in the optional logical columns local and observed using observation data from iNaturalist. Existing values are retained.

Usage

enrich_local_observed(
  file,
  delim = ",",
  local_country = NULL,
  user = NULL,
  progress = TRUE,
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

file

path to the csv file

delim

the delimiter used in the file

local_country

character giving the name of the country that is considered local. If supplied, the taxonomy file must contain a local column.

user

character giving the iNaturalist user name whose observations should be considered. If supplied, the taxonomy file must contain an observed column.

progress

Whether to show a progress bar.

quiet

Whether to suppress informational output while values are fetched.

Value

a taxonomy_graph with added values in local, observed, or both. The file given by file is overwritten as a side effect.

Details

At least one of local_country and user must be supplied. If both are supplied, both metadata columns are enriched.

Only leaf taxa with rank Gattung, Art, or Unterart are queried. A taxon is considered local when iNaturalist contains at least two research-grade observations from local_country. A taxon is considered observed when iNaturalist contains at least one research-grade observation by user.

To limit the number of API requests, at most 200 taxa are processed per call.
